purpose.zh: 练身体侧面，单手提重物时身体不歪
purpose.en: Build the sides of your trunk so you stay upright carrying weight in one hand.

text.zh: 一手提哑铃站直，身体不往任何一边歪
text.en: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand tall without leaning

text.zh: 两边肩膀一样高，正常呼吸。
text.en: Keep your shoulders level and breathe normally.

text.zh: 时间到后慢慢放下，换手再做。
text.en: Set it down slowly, then switch hands.

cautions.zh: 腰或肩膀疼时停止，换轻一点的哑铃
cautions.en: If your back or shoulder hurts, stop and use a lighter dumbbell.

changes: 动画全程静止 → kind hold（App 计时），每侧 30 秒；dose mode hold→time
名字「静态提握抗侧屈」是术语，改「单手提哑铃站立」
purpose 去掉「侧腹」以外的书面语；caution 改「X 时 Y」
